signature.name: VTask.radical
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {M : Type u_2} -> {P : Type u_4} -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [AddCommGroup P] -> [CommRing R] -> [Module R M] -> [Module R P] -> (Q : QuadraticMap R M P) -> Submodule R M

conventions.statement: An element x : M is in VTask.radical Q if and only if Q x = 0 and polarBilin Q x = 0 (as a linear map M → P), i.e., the polar form vanishes identically in the direction of x.
conventions.note: Both conditions are required simultaneously; the polar condition alone is insufficient in characteristic 2.

conventions.statement: The zero vector always belongs to VTask.radical Q, so the radical is never empty.
conventions.note: Follows from Q 0 = 0 and linearity of polarBilin Q at 0.

conventions.statement: In characteristic 2 the radical can be strictly smaller than the kernel of polarBilin Q because the condition Q x = 0 is an independent requirement.
conventions.note: In characteristic not 2, radical equals the kernel of the polar bilinear form.

facts.statement: ∀ {R M P : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup P] [CommRing R] [Module R M] [Module R P] (Q : QuadraticMap R M P) (m : M), m ∈ VTask.radical Q ↔ Q m = 0 ∧ ∀ n : M, Q (m + n) = Q n
